summary: Main and secondary numerical checks pass. The original full-caption discrepancy was corrected with new stable outputs; scientific assurance remains same-family/provisional.

gt_provenance.details: Native captions use dataset GT; relation labels are assistant-authored pixel proxies with same-family pre-score review. Main/object IDs and RGB hashes are disjoint; historical weights have prior train/val exposure.

score_normalization.details: Midrank selects candidates; metrics use fixed counts, cosine margins, and reciprocal rank. No own-max performance normalization. Ties and bootstrap independently verified. Native exact-negative ties counted zero.

result_existence.details: All raw and reported artifacts exist. Original full-caption exact-tie outputs differed across independent numerical execution; new stable outputs reproduce exactly and report now uses them.

dead_code.details: Claimed metric functions have execution outputs; rollout/reward/scorer hashes match bindings. No policy update was triggered by the failed gate. Historical tool threshold 0 verified.

scope.details: One frozen UCM deployment; 44 train and 16 heldout photos, 11 object photos; 8 candidate draws plus greedy, no independent trained-policy runs. Qualified report matches pilot scope.

eval_type.details: Dataset caption retrieval is real_gt; assistant-pixel direction/object labels and rotation diagnostics are synthetic_proxy. RFPO target identity is dataset-provided but its reward is a model proxy.

resolved_findings.item: Original full-caption result differs under independent recomputation
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserve original files; use fixed-order unique-token scoring then expand ownership; publish full_caption_stable.json and stable draws; update report.
resolved_findings.cause_assessment: Floating-point exact-tie sensitivity is a plausible explanation; original full score matrix was not retained.

resolved_findings.item: Legacy both_random and both_AB use different view coupling
resolved_findings.resolution: paired_choice.json explicitly provides independent and common-quantile coupling for both selectors; report uses independent.

resolved_findings.item: Tool wrapper returns low-confidence top3 despite CLI default 0.29
resolved_findings.resolution: Historical archived pipeline sets threshold 0; current generation agrees with that deployment and report states it.

Verified final report numeric update and local cross-device hash record.
review_trace.scope: CPU artifact recomputation; original GPU execution and server source assets supported by stored execution bindings/logs. Server output hashes in stable_cross_device.json are execution-team evidence, local hashes independently checked.
